title: PDF to Text – Extract Text from PDF Free, No Upload
description: Extract all the text of a PDF in your browser and save it as a .txt file, with each page marked, Arabic in reading order. Free, nothing is uploaded.
heading: PDF to text
subtitle: Get all the text of a PDF as a plain .txt file, page by page; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Convert PDF to text online and download a plain .txt file: the text of every page comes out line by line, with optional markers where each page starts, and Arabic text keeps its right-to-left reading order. Nothing is uploaded, and scanned PDFs are recognised and explained, because they hold pictures instead of text.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Readable text
features.text: Lines follow the page, each page can be marked, and Arabic text comes out in reading order.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, the tool keeps working without an internet connection.

stepsTitle: How to convert PDF to text

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page.

steps.title: Get the text
steps.text: Choose whether to mark where each page starts, then click Get the text.

steps.title: Check and download
steps.text: The preview shows the first lines; download the .txt file.

handles: Text: every page in order, lines rebuilt from the page layout.
Arabic: words come out in reading order, ready to paste.
Page markers: optional --- Page 3 --- headings between pages.
Scanned PDFs: detected and explained; run OCR PDF first to read them.
limits: Scanned PDFs hold pictures of pages, so there is no text to get; run OCR PDF first.
Tables and columns come out as lines of text, not as a table.
PDFs that need a password to open can't be read; remove the password first.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Why is no text found?
faq.answer: The PDF is probably scanned: its pages are pictures, with no text inside. Run OCR PDF first, which reads the words in your browser, then convert the new copy here.

faq.question: Does it work with Arabic PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. Arabic text comes out in reading order, right to left, ready to paste.

faq.question: Can I use a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not directly: a PDF that needs a password to open can't be read by this tool. If you know the password, remove it with Unlock PDF, which also runs in your browser, then try again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.

faq.question: How do I copy text from a PDF?
faq.answer: Select the text in any PDF reader and copy it, or save all of it at once as a .txt file with a PDF to text converter; a scanned PDF needs text recognition (OCR) first. OpenAnyDoc's PDF to text saves every page's text in your browser, Arabic in reading order, without uploading the file.
